target: Fulfill the canonical intent of engos-delivery-address-code-review.
intended_outcome: Preserve the canonical SSOT objective and required output.

primary_outcome.definition: Canonical task success with protected behavior preserved.

promotion_rule: Change-class-specific proof plus all hard gates; no aggregate compensation.
rollback_trigger: Any protected regression or stale bound evidence.

source_clause_hashes.text: Use this only after there is an existing PR/MR review thread, inline comment, requested-change discussion, or explicit reviewer note to address. If the user has not received review feedback yet and wants a quality gate before committing or pushing, use `engos-quality-code-review` instead.
Read open review comments from a PR/MR, present them to the user, apply the requested changes with minimal scope, and prepare a commit with only the reviewer-requested fixes.
| "Address only comments 2 and 4" | `engos-delivery-address-code-review` | selected-comment implementation with narrow scope |

Do not use `engos-delivery-address-code-review` to proactively improve code, clean up adjacent issues, or review a diff before a reviewer has commented. It should only mutate files that are tied to selected review feedback.
- forbidden: modifying code that has no associated review comment, silent bulk refactors, resolving comments without applying the fix
## Required Inputs
## Required Output
Honor an already explicit authorized selection (all or specific IDs). Ask only if selection is materially ambiguous.
Do not edit files until the selected comment set is clear.
- Stage only the files that were modified to address comments.
- Push to the existing remote branch only when the supplied task authorizes that step; otherwise stop with the requested patch or commit guidance.
- **Only modify code that has an associated review comment.** Do not touch other changed lines in the diff that have no comments.
- Do not resolve/close review threads programmatically — let the reviewer verify.
- Do not mix unrelated changes into the fix commit.
| Scope discipline | Only reviewer-requested changes are made, nothing else |
| Commit hygiene | Fix commit contains only the review-related changes |

When delegating or returning selected feedback, load the `handoff` route in `resources/resource-map.json`: `resources/references/feedback-handoff.md`. Preserve immutable original IDs, source references/digests, selection accepted|rejected|deferred|unselected, authority reasons and actual outcomes separately. Already clear selection requires no second confirmation. Accepted but unfinished remains unresolved/deferred, never addressed without repair evidence. Direct bounded D5 worker needs no Batman. Only explicit Batman uses its controller envelope and independent gates. Optional committed packages resolve the verified code-review owner; no copied collector or guessed sibling. Preserve separately hashed dirty snapshot identity. Task receipts do not waive final integration review or GitOps; no automatic hosted thread closure.

The review-fix owner keeps the original selection ledger: comment_id, source_ref, source_digest when captured, decision accepted|rejected|deferred|unselected, decision reason/authority_ref, bounded task link, current outcome and actual repair evidence. IDs are immutable; later comments need an explicit selection decision. Honor an already clear selection; clarify only material ambiguity.

Dispatch the bounded request or exact TaskContract bytes directly to an ordinary implementation worker. The worker needs no Batman/planner/testing sibling. Return every supplied relevant ID. Accepted A becomes addressed only with observed scoped repair evidence; accepted-but-unfinished remains unresolved/deferred with reason while the owner's decision stays accepted. Rejected B stays rejected, deferred C stays deferred, unselected D stays unselected and none grants implementation permission. Keep selection, SliceReceipt outcome, Findings disposition, accepted-risk authority and hosted thread resolution distinct. Do not post or close threads automatically.

Explicit Batman may dispatch the same TaskContract with its separate task_id/owner_id/plan_generation/read-write/authority/evidence/stop envelope. Controller does not implement, author failing tests/fixes or self-review. All existing independent review, attacker, milestone and landing gates remain required. Stale/missing worker or reviewer results cannot satisfy a current node.

An optional committed handoff resolves the verified installed engos-quality-code-review owner, selects its collect/verify-package routes and validates externally retained subject/target/source/result bindings before findings consumption. Do not copy collector/schema into this owner or guess missing sibling paths. Missing owner makes that option unavailable; a normal dirty snapshot remains separate and truthful. A task receipt never waives final full-branch review/GitOps.
